## Astraeus 2.8.4

### New
- **A pill on every screen.** Turn on **Pill on every screen** under Settings → Screens to get the long pill on each monitor at once. Each screen keeps its own size, blur and fullscreen state, so a game on one screen doesn't hide the pills on the others. Off by default: the pill still follows the mouse between screens. Thanks to @jorjanion for building this!
- **Drink Water reminders.** Set "Remind me over, hours" in the Drink Water widget and a banner drops from the island with **Drink** and **Snooze**. The glasses still to drink are spread over the hours left, and the reminders stop once you reach your goal. The widget also shows how much you've had in litres. Right-click it to set your goal, glass size and reminders; a left click still adds a glass.
- **Move and resize the waveform.** In the fullscreen editor the waveform is now a part of its own: drag it anywhere and pull its corner to resize it.

### Improved
- **A livelier waveform.** Each bar now moves between its own quietest and loudest, so the bars no longer sit at full height, and the bass and treble ends respond alike.
- **Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu lyrics** now read and sweep right to left, keeping the alignment you picked.
- **Lighter lyrics.** The blur behind each line only covers the words themselves, which uses much less video memory, most of all with centered or right-aligned lyrics.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
